canvasSize.description: Exact final square pixel canvas; independent of gameplay hitbox.

layout.description: cutout fits an isolated soft-alpha subject; strip preserves the full frame/UV through keying+resize, no crop/recenter/refit/rotation. Either can serve either renderer.

prompt.description: One isolated texture ingredient consistent with accepted Visual; no UI/text/atlas. A strip may fill its long axis. No weapon/PCA/silhouette heuristics.

anyOf.description: Engine units: Retained presentation metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not a physical intensity or budget multiplier.

chaos.description: Engine units: Retained motif metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not a probability.

rhythm.description: Engine units: Retained motif metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not beats per minute or a time unit.

alpha.description: Engine units: Legacy draw opacity/volume coefficient: sprite/primitive RGB and alpha are scaled together; detached effects fade over lifetime; sound volume clamp(alpha,0.05,1). Additive zeroes vertex alpha after scaling RGB. Dust color paths do not use slot alpha; not universal opacity. spriteElement and texturedPath: multiply alpha by opacityProfile once, apply tint to RGB separately, no extra implicit lifetime fade; explicit zero is silence.

anchor.description: Primitive/cue/event placement: self/field=bound entity center; owner=active owner center; tip/tipHistory=projectile geometric tip (item uses engine itemLocation); velocity=center with motion axis; hitPoint=captured event point, NPC center for item hit/crit. Item hitPoint without a captured point is silent. Projectile event anchors and sprite pose are frozen at emission and carried through the relay, including after source removal; unavailable owner is silent. History renderers use their named center/tip histories instead of relocating the path.

backend.description: Legacy retained implementation hint; rendererKind selects the implemented Dust/FNA path. Installing ParticleLibrary does not redirect slots. Auto is sufficient for legacy renderers. spriteElement requires Sprite; texturedPath requires Primitive, both use owned stock FNA paths.

budgetWeight.description: Engine units: Retained weighting metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Does not multiply an enforced particle/draw budget.

density.description: Engine units: Procedural tessellation/mote count as specified in rendererSemantics. Particle count/cadence remains separate: projectile periodic repeatEvery=0 uses clamp(14-round(8*density),4,18) world ticks; projectile impactRing/childMotes count clamp(2+round(8*density),2,10), item dust count clamp(1+round(7*density),1,8), subject to client scaling and budgets. Not particles per world tick.

duration.description: Legacy world ticks: detached sprite and primitive lifetime with linear lifetime fade; procedural periodic animation period when repeatEvery=0. Active history trails and straight beams do not consume duration. Event rings also have their own phase fade. spriteElement: individual lifetime in world ticks, opacityProfile owns lifetime opacity (no extra linear fade). texturedPath: neutral=3, history/source owns lifetime.

accelerationXPxPerTickSquared.description: Pixels per world tick squared, X in selected attachment frame.

accelerationYPxPerTickSquared.description: Pixels per world tick squared, Y in selected attachment frame.

attachment.description: world freezes event-time frame; source follows that exact live source generation in its forward/normal frame, ends on retirement. World acceleration uses world X/Y; source acceleration uses local frame.

colorProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Exact RGB token; effect captures existing effect color, white preserves texture RGB. Opacity is separate.

middle.description: Exact RGB token; effect captures existing effect color, white preserves texture RGB. Opacity is separate.

start.description: Exact RGB token; effect captures existing effect color, white preserves texture RGB. Opacity is separate.

count.description: Integer elements per emission; zero is silence. Charged when emitted, never per Draw.

drag.description: Velocity retention per world tick (1 keeps velocity; 0 removes it).

heightProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

middle.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

start.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

heightPx.description: Pixels along texture Y axis, independent of width; zero stays zero.

inheritVelocity.description: Fraction of captured engine velocity, converted to pixels per world tick and added once: Projectile.velocity * (1 + extraUpdates), Player.velocity unchanged. This is not measured anchor displacement; a position-driven controller can use engine velocity as steering. Runtime captures the conversion before source retirement; legacy Dust velocity semantics are unchanged.

offsetForwardPx.description: Pixels along captured source forward at emission.

offsetSidePx.description: Pixels along captured source normal at emission.

opacityProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

middle.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

start.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

rotationRadians.description: Radians relative to captured forward; never inferred image/PCA axis.

speedMaxPxPerTick.description: Pixels per world tick, uniform speed maximum >= speedMinPxPerTick.

speedMinPxPerTick.description: Pixels per world tick, uniform speed minimum.

spreadRadians.description: Radians: full cone around captured forward.

texture.description: Explicit exact item/entity/impact image role or one declared asset ID. No paths/URLs; no cross-entity guesses. impact requires that entity's existing impactSprite producer.

widthProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

middle.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

start.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

widthPx.description: Pixels along texture X axis, independent of height; zero stays zero.

fadeIn.description: Engine units: Retained metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not seconds, world ticks, or a lifetime fraction.

fadeOut.description: Engine units: Retained metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not seconds, world ticks, or a lifetime fraction; impactSprite has its own fixed linear fade.

jitter.description: Engine units: Retained metadata; currently no renderer consumer. No pixel, angle, or time unit.

accelerationXPxPerTickSquared.description: World X acceleration, pixels/world tick squared.

accelerationYPxPerTickSquared.description: World Y acceleration, pixels/world tick squared.

colorEnd.description: Final RGB token, linearly interpolated over individual lifetime.

colorStart.description: Initial opaque RGB token; effect captures accepted effect color; no palette-prose parsing.

count.description: Integer particles per emission; zero is silence; shares existing instance budgets.

drag.description: Velocity retention per world tick; 1 preserves, 0 removes previous velocity before world acceleration.

endOpacity.description: Final opacity multiplier, linearly interpolated from 1 and multiplied by common alpha once.

endScaleMultiplier.description: Final width/height multiplier, linearly interpolated from 1; zero contracts to nothing.

heightPx.description: Full initial height of the library unit quad in world pixels; zero stays zero.

inheritVelocity.description: Fraction of captured world-tick engine velocity added once, Projectile.velocity*MaxUpdates or Player.velocity.

rotationRadians.description: Initial rotation relative to captured source forward, radians.

speedMaxPxPerTick.description: Maximum initial speed, must be >= speedMinPxPerTick.

speedMinPxPerTick.description: Minimum initial speed in world pixels/world tick.

spreadRadians.description: Full cone angle around captured source forward, radians.

textureId.description: Exact ParticleLibrary built-in Star texture: opaque grayscale including black texels. Alpha blend includes its black rectangular footprint; additive makes black contribute zero. Choose blend explicitly. Not a motion/weapon preset; no PNG generation.

widthPx.description: Full initial width of the library unit quad in world pixels, independent of texture native dimensions; zero stays zero.

particleSystemId.description: Exact Terraria dust selectors, not ParticleLibrary instances: dust=GemDiamond, pl:glow=TintableDustLighted, pl:shard=Glass, pl:smoke=Smoke, pl:spark=Electric. none suppresses particles, not independently selected primitive/sprite/light/sound rendering.

colorProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Exact RGB token; effect captures existing effect color, white preserves texture RGB. Opacity is separate.

middle.description: Exact RGB token; effect captures existing effect color, white preserves texture RGB. Opacity is separate.

start.description: Exact RGB token; effect captures existing effect color, white preserves texture RGB. Opacity is separate.

historyTicks.description: World ticks retained: 2..32 for history, 0 for current geometry.

maxSegmentLengthPx.description: Pixels: skip true gaps, never bridge/smooth into invented paths.

minDistancePx.description: Pixels between accepted history samples; 0 for current geometry.

opacityProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

middle.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

start.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

profileDomain.description: age uses each retained history sample age/historyTicks; length uses normalized cumulative geometric length. History can select either; current beam/whip geometry requires length.

repeatLengthPx.description: Pixels per texture repeat along cumulative geometric distance. stretch requires 1.

scrollPxPerTick.description: UV pixels per world-clock tick; stretch requires 0.

source.description: Actual timestamped anchor history or exact accepted beam/whip collision geometry, read-only. Never approximate trajectory/range from item name or sprite. Preserve all collision corners.

texture.description: Explicit exact item/entity/impact image role or one declared asset ID. No paths/URLs; no cross-entity guesses. impact requires that entity's existing impactSprite producer.

widthProfile.description: Knots at normalized profile coordinate 0, 0.5, 1: sprite lifetime age, or path profileDomain age/length. Curve per half interval: linear=t; easeIn=t*t; easeOut=1-(1-t)^2; smoothStep=t*t*(3-2*t). Captured immutably at emission.

end.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

middle.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

start.description: Dimensionless multiplier (opacity coefficient for opacityProfile); explicit zero stays zero.

widthPx.description: Authored decorative pixels, not collision geometry width; zero stays zero.

rendererKind.description: Select the renderer with the companion fields required by this slot's conditional clauses. lightCue emits world lighting, not a drawn glow sprite or trail. Sound/light cues use lane=cue, not a visual emphasis lane.

repeatEvery.description: Legacy world ticks: positive value sets periodic particle/cue cadence and procedural animation period. 0 selects automatic particle cadence (projectile clamp(14-round(8*density),4,18), item 10) and uses duration for procedural period. Item periodic uses global ticks plus seed phase; projectile uses its state world ticks. Event particles do not repeat, but detached procedural shapes may animate within their duration. spriteElement: periodic cadence >=1 world tick, nonperiodic requires 0; overlap is literal and bounded. texturedPath: neutral=0; no repeated detached path emission.

scale.description: Engine units: Renderer-specific scale (1 nominal); procedural dimensions/thickness are specified in rendererSemantics. Sprite trail scale=max(0.05, projectile.scale*scale); projectile event afterimage scale=clamp(projectile.scale,0.1,8)*scale; directional item/impact sprite scale clamps to 0.05..8. Light strength clamp(0.22*scale,0.04,1.2) on projectile or clamp(0.2*scale,0.04,1.2) on item, then client multiplier. Dust size clamp(scale,0.2,3). Not a universal pixel size.

angularVarianceRadians.description: Random angular variance around the explicitly selected direction, in radians.

directionRadians.description: Direction angle relative to captured source forward, in radians.

dissipationPxPerFrame.description: Strength removed on each native ModifyScreenPosition visit, not a world-tick lifetime; passed explicitly to Luminance.

strengthPx.description: Luminance camera displacement strength in screen pixels before its client screenshake modifier; explicit zero emits no shake.

taperEndDistancePx.description: Distance where attenuation reaches zero; must exceed taperStartDistancePx.

taperStartDistancePx.description: Distance from resolved event anchor to the viewing player where attenuation begins, in world pixels.

signatureWeight.description: Engine units: Retained weighting metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not an enforced budget fraction.

spread.description: Engine units: Particle-speed coefficient, not angle or radians: projectile dust speed clamp(0.35+1.7*spread, 0.2, 4) plus inherited velocity; item dust velocity sampled from circular radii 1+spread. Angle is selected separately; not one common physical speed.

spritePrompt.description: The final impact PNG has a transparent background; describe the raw image on a perfectly solid untextured pure flat magenta background (#ff00ff), object fully separated from background, no floor, no cast shadow, no gradient. Local postprocess owns final alpha; do not confuse raw background with final transparency.

startTick.description: Legacy projectile periodic only: initial particle/cue gate on per-projectile world ticks; also delays periodic procedural wave/ring/arc/orbit visibility. Active history/sprite trails and straight beams retain their existing draw timing. Legacy item periodic and detached/event lifetimes ignore startTick. spriteElement/libraryParticle: nonperiodic event-relative emission delay; periodic projectile age gate, item periodic requires 0. screenShakeCue: nonperiodic event-relative delay in world ticks, not camera lifetime. texturedPath: projectile age gate for live sampling.

textureRole.description: Legacy PNG selector for projectileAfterimage, spriteStampTrail, actorAfterimage, impactSprite: item=accepted item PNG; entity=bound entity baked_sprite/reuse_item_icon PNG (no_asset/runtime_geometry cannot supply one); projectile/field alias entity only when equal to bound visualRole, with the same mode requirement; impact=same-entity impactSprite producer (required companion slot for other sprite renderers); none invalid for sprites. Primitive/Dust/cue renderer hints require no PNG. spriteElement and texturedPath require none here and consume only their explicit nested texture selector and textureDependencyTuples.

visualCost.description: Engine units: Retained cost metadata; currently no renderer consumer. Not draw calls or an enforced budget fraction.
